gen_command_line_try_get_arg.technical_finding: Enforces -key=value format strictly. Space-separated arguments (-key value) are completely ignored because arg does not contain '='. Values with internal '=' fail split.Length == 2 check.

gen_file_paths_save_data_folder.technical_finding: Vanilla RimWorld natively evaluates -savedatafolder=<path> via GenCommandLine at the earliest startup stage, overrides GenFilePaths.saveDataPath, and creates the directory. Passing -savedatafolder="{SelectedUserDataDirectory}" to child process satisfies frontend UserData routing natively without bytecode modification.

static_constructor_on_startup_utility.technical_finding: Invoked during PlayDataLoader.DoPlayLoad queued in LongEventHandler. Executes WorkerBridgeBootstrapper.cctor() synchronously before interactive gameplay.

unity_add_component_and_awake.technical_finding: Unity native engine invokes MonoBehaviour.Awake synchronously on the calling thread inside AddComponent before returning. WorkerBridgeBootstrapper installs _activeAdmissionReceipt into WorkerBridgeComponent immediately before calling AddComponent, guaranteeing receipt presence in Awake.

analyzed_spans.finding: Parses only self7 arguments (-operatorconfig, -operatorconfigsha, -operatororigin, -operatorlaunchplan, -operatorconfigid, -operatorrole, -operatorcapability) for current process. Has zero logic to receive or admit a paired child configuration.
Maintains single static slot for own startup receipt. Has zero slots for a separate admitted child receipt.

Reads executable, working directory, and arguments directly from parent _activeStartupConfig. Formats child arguments as '--task-file ... --nonce ...' without passing 7 operator CLI flags. Child process would immediately fail-closed in WorkerBridgeBootstrapper.

searched_source_roots_and_callsites.finding: Dedicated Server hosts WorldTickManager, DiplomacyManager, DynamicMarketManager, FeudalManager, and TcpNetworkServer (port 7777). Contains zero operator producer, zero child launcher, and zero admission receipt generation code.
Driver script launches RimWorld with [-batchmode, -savedatafolder=..., -logFile=..., -bridgeport=...]. Does not pass operator CLI arguments.

producer_presence_determination: MISSING_FROM_RUNTIME_SOURCE: An actual operator-owned producer that supplies a paired READ_ONLY child configuration and declaration to the live simulation worker does not exist in any live codebase root.
